title: BiggerPockets Alternatives
keyLine: Forums teach deals. Our plan writes 12 months from your tax file.
description: BiggerPockets compared with Legacy Wealth Blueprint: free forums vs a written wealth plan, Preston Seo's path, and public competitor prices. We do not print our tuition.
answer: BiggerPockets is a real estate site with free forums, free podcasts, and a paid Pro membership. It helps you study deals. It is not a full money plan. Legacy Wealth Blueprint is what Preston Seo teaches after a corporate job, a house-hacked duplex, and a $15M+ portfolio with his wife: a written 12-month order for tax, debt, income, investing, and protection, plus a guide and a CPA brief. Stay on BiggerPockets if the job is listings. Use us if the job is one written order. Cheap rental memberships exist if you need neither. We do not publish our tuition here.
criteriaIntro: The comparison pole is BiggerPockets versus our wealth plan. Other cheap tools sit below so you are not forced into either product. We do not rank KenPro against SubTo.
criteria: BiggerPockets facts come from their public pages and a dated staff post.
Blueprint facts come from our membership page and about page.
Other options appear only as cheaper doors if you need neither product.
We do not publish our fee here.

blocks.heading: Who is on our side of this page
paragraphs: [Preston Seo](/about/preston-seo) founded Legacy Investing Show in 2020. His parents were first-generation immigrants. After college he took a corporate job and left within a year. The [about page](/about) says he then studied taxes, cash flow, investing, and ownership. He started with a house-hacked duplex while working sales. With his wife he built a $15M+ real estate portfolio. Seven years sit between debt in 2017 and that figure.

The portfolio is the result. The system is [Legacy Wealth Blueprint](/legacy-wealth-blueprint): a Wealth Strategy Snapshot from your numbers, a dedicated guide, weekly coaching, and a CPA Implementation Brief you hand to your own preparer. You keep your CPA. You do not have to buy a rental on day one.

blocks.heading: What BiggerPockets is
paragraphs: BiggerPockets is a real estate media and community company. You can read forums, listen to podcasts, and use deal tools. A [staff post on March 3, 2026](https://www.biggerpockets.com/forums/48/topics/1280018-new-to-biggerpockets-pro-insurance-and-loan-discounts) said Pro costs $32.50 a month when billed once a year. A [membership comparison page](https://blogdev.biggerpockets.com/membership-types) also lists Pro at $39 a month, or $32.50 a month billed yearly.

The [bootcamps URL](https://www.biggerpockets.com/bootcamps) we opened on September 15, 2026 showed free guides and a prompt to upgrade to Pro. It did not show a live checkout price. An older membership table lists online bootcamps at $199 each. Confirm the current class on their site.
You do not need us if the free forums already answer your questions. You need a different product when you want a written plan for tax, debt, and investing, not just rentals.

blocks.intro: These are cheaper doors, not a bake-off between other brands.

items.name: Stay free: forums and podcasts
items.summary: Keep using BiggerPockets forums plus the [BiggerPockets Real Estate Podcast](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/biggerpockets-real-estate-podcast/id594419649). Reddit threads are free too, but quality varies.

items.name: KenPro (Ken McElroy)
items.summary: A paid membership around rental and apartment education. [Ken's store page](https://kenmcelroy.com/kenprostore/) lists Ken Pro at $39.99 a month or $399 a year. Older pages still show $29.99. Use the live store price.
items.meta: Job: cheap paid lessons without a high-ticket call

items.name: A fee-only planner or CPA
items.summary: If you need advice on your file, buy hours from a licensed person, not a forum. The [FTC](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/when-business-offer-or-coaching-program-scam) warns that coaching programs which promise easy real estate profits are often a scam.
items.meta: Job: advice on your numbers. Fee varies.

blocks.label: Watch for this
paragraphs: Many 'BiggerPockets alternatives' articles rank software: PropStream, DealMachine, Roofstock. Those help you find a property. They do not replace education, and they are not our wealth plan. If a page ranks 11 tools and never says who wrote it, treat it as a lead list.

whoFits: You already used free BiggerPockets content and you are deciding whether a written wealth plan is a different job.
You want the comparison to be BiggerPockets versus us, not a software bake-off.
whoSkips: You have not listened to a single episode or read a forum thread yet. Start free.
You want a ranked list of skip-tracing apps. That is a different search.

faqs.q: Is there a free BiggerPockets alternative?
faqs.a: Yes. The free BiggerPockets forums and podcasts are the first alternative to paying. Paid options start when you want structure, a calculator pack, or a written wealth plan.
A March 3, 2026 BiggerPockets staff post said $32.50 a month billed yearly. A membership table also shows $39 a month. Check biggerpockets.com before you buy.

faqs.q: Is Legacy Wealth Blueprint a BiggerPockets alternative?
faqs.a: Only if your job is a full money plan. It is not a deal marketplace or a landlord forum. Read [what's in Blueprint](/compare/legacy-wealth-blueprint-what-to-know).
PropStream is a data tool, not a class. Buy data when you are already looking at markets. Do not buy it to learn what a rental is.
